set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Volume and mesh use the same spatial4s nominal frame types without competing frame algebra or registry.
- An independently usable anatomical-declarations artifact serves image/surface/atlas consumers without pulling volume operations, IO, transforms, display or ScalaFIM.
- Generic directional transforms remain in reframe4s; coherent provider pins pass frame/unit/convention/direction and scanner/tkRAS oracles.

Close after child implementation tasks satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md. The numbered gates do not serialize unrelated tasks.
set.title: U2 milestone: Share coordinate types and lightweight anatomical declarations
